gloss: no mistakes; flawless run; perfect performance

definitions.gloss: no mistakes; flawless run; perfect performance
definitions.explanation: Completing a task, game, performance, or test without a single mistake. Japanese-coined loanword from English 'no' + 'miss'. Common in sports, music, gaming, and test-taking contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ノーミス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Today I cleared it with no mistakes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ノーミス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}→演奏：01896_ensou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{終|お}えた→終える：02019_oeru⟧。
examples.english: She finished her performance without a single mistake.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大事|だいじ}→大事：01253_daiji⟧な⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ノーミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{続|つづ}け→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧られる⟦{選手|せんしゅ}→選手：03823_senshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{本当|ほんとう}→本当：00779_hontou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧。
examples.english: A player who can keep making no mistakes in important moments is truly strong.

notes:
Japanese-coined loanword from English "no" + "miss." Used as a noun and adverbially with ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧. Functions as the casual antonym of ⟦ケアレスミス→ケアレスミス：27420_kearesumisu⟧. Note that "no miss" in this exact form is not used in English — it is wasei-eigo.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ノーミス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦クリア→クリア：10825_kuria⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to clear (a game/stage) with no mistakes
- ノーミス⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{演奏|えんそう}する→演奏する：20349_ensousuru⟧: to perform without a mistake
- ノーミス⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧: to aim for a flawless run
- ノーミス⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{続|つづ}く→続く：00903_tsuzuku⟧: a streak of error-free attempts continues

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ケアレスミス→ケアレスミス：27420_kearesumisu⟧: careless mistake — direct counterpart describing the errors that ノーミス avoids
- ⟦{完璧|かんぺき}→完璧：09505_kanpeki⟧: perfect — adjectival; broader, includes flawless quality, not just absence of mistakes
- パーフェクト: perfect — loanword; often used for full marks or perfect scores
